title: Nammura Hammira
desc: A wealthy girl decides to teach a man a lesson by pretending to be in love with him. However, things take an ugly turn when the man marries her in a fit of rage.

title: Hostel Hudugaru Bekagiddare
desc: A group of students who are suspects in a boy's hostel warden's death craft a plan to hide his corpse after they find a note left by him.

title: Sirai
desc: A police officer escorts a prisoner from Vellore prison to Sivagangai court. However, unexpected interactions occur between the two during the long transit, challenging their perspectives.

title: Elumale
desc: A chance encounter near the Tamil Nadu-Karnataka border in 2004 plunges a cab driver and a young woman into a tense night filled with lurking threats.

title: Rider
desc: As love blossoms between orphans Chinnu and Kitty, fate separates them as children. However, they grow up yearning to find each other.

title: Jogi
desc: After a crime lord is murdered by Madesha, Nivedhitha, a journalist, sets out to meet him. She ends up meeting an old woman and promises to help her find her son, who is none other than Madesha.
